newsitem.title: USA: Consumer spending, incomes up modestly in May.
newsitem.headline: Consumer spending, incomes up modestly in May.

text.p: Consumer spending picked up modestly in May from April's pace as incomes kept growing, the Commerce Department said on Monday, suggesting steady economic expansion ahead.

Spending increased 0.3 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of $5.37 trillion after a slight 0.1 percent gain in April. Incomes from wages, salaries and all other sources rose an identical 0.3 percent in May to $6.77 trillion following a 0.2 percent pickup in April.
